source: pseudopeople's identifier for a simulated person
notes: The ground truth: the same value in two files means the same simulated person. Exactly one row per value in each file. Not a real person; no real-world meaning.

noise: leave_blank; use_nickname; use_fake_name; make_phonetic_errors; make_ocr_errors; make_typos (each 1% of cells)
notes: Nicknames come from pseudopeople's nickname list (e.g. Jeanette -> Nettie).
No name change at marriage: a person's last name is the same in every record.

noise: leave_blank; copy_from_household_member; swap_month_and_day; write_wrong_digits; make_ocr_errors; make_typos (each 1% of cells; the last three alter each digit of a touched cell with probability 0.1, so a touched date may change one digit, several, or none)
notes: Read as text: about 1.4% of non-blank values are not valid calendar dates after noise (e.g. a month above 12).

format: AIAN | Asian | Black | Latino | Multiracial or Other | NHOPI | White
notes: pseudopeople's seven categories: Latino is an ethnicity that takes precedence over race; AIAN = American Indian and Alaska Native; NHOPI = Native Hawaiian and Other Pacific Islander.

format: digits; rarely a range such as 64,66 (then quoted in the CSV)
blanks: registry 1%, finder files 5%, plus source addresses that carry no number
noise: leave_blank (registry 1%, finder files 5%); write_wrong_digits; make_ocr_errors; make_typos (each 1%)
notes: Set the CSV quote character to " when loading (DuckDB's sniffer may miss it).

noise: leave_blank (registry 1%, finder files 5%); make_phonetic_errors; make_ocr_errors; make_typos (each 1%)
notes: Simulated street: not a real location. Do not geocode.

blanks: most records, because most addresses have no unit; registry 1%, finder files 5% on top
noise: leave_blank (registry 1%, finder files 5%); write_wrong_digits; make_ocr_errors; make_typos (each 1%)

format: lower case Florida place name; 'unincorporated' for unincorporated areas
noise: leave_blank (registry 1%, finder files 5%); make_phonetic_errors; make_ocr_errors; make_typos (each 1%)
notes: Real Florida city and place names.
Every person is a Florida resident in the record's census year, so any value other than FL is noise.

noise: leave_blank (registry 1%, finder files 5%); write_wrong_zipcode_digits; make_ocr_errors; make_typos (each 1%)
notes: Read as text, not as a number. Real Florida ZIP codes.

blanks: registry 5% (realised higher, because people who never held an SSN in the simulation have none), finder files 20%
source: pseudopeople Social Security observer, joined on simulant_id
noise: blanked to the file's target share (config.yaml noise.*.ssn_missing); two adjacent digits swapped in 1% of finder-file SSNs (noise.finder.ssn_transposed); one digit replaced in 0.5% of registry SSNs (noise.registry.ssn_wrong_digit); no other errors
notes: Syntactically valid, never issued to anyone. A swap or a wrong digit can produce a number outside the SSA's issued ranges. Borrowed numbers (a household member's SSN) are out of scope in this version; see README.md.

A day drawn uniformly within the year of the census the record was drawn from, so diagnoses fall in 2020, 2030 or 2040 only. Age at diagnosis = diagnosis_date minus date_of_birth. Not modelled as a clinical event: no site, stage or vital status.
